title: APS first Check APS and APS Live branch fixture
scope: First Check APS after join, shared baseline confirmation, and APS Live function / branch coverage before true two-machine UAT.
boundary: This fixture locks acceptable first-screen and branch behavior. It is not real human UAT, not true two-machine evidence, not real Trystero reliability, and not real Drive timing proof.

checkApsCases.localState: The user has joined an APS cooperation directory, peers are confirmed, and no valid shared_goal_and_roles baseline exists.
checkApsCases.acceptableFirstScreen: 🔎 目前已接上 APS 交換區與 APS 合作目錄，協作者已加入；但未有共同基準。畫面必須用表格顯示 APS 流程位置，並用「👉 目前位置」標示「2. 建立共同目標與分工」。建議下一步是先建立共同目標與分工，暫時不要發普通交接。若需要即時核對，我會打開 APS Live 交接追蹤；頁面應顯示「共同基準：未通過 / 需處理」與「需先建立共同目標與分工」。
checkApsCases.behindTheScenes: Run whole-project status through Check APS, inspect peer cards and shared-goal state, generate or refresh APS Live only if useful, and avoid packet / ack mutation.
forbidden: 未有共同基準仍說可以開工
把 check Drive 當整體狀態
要求用戶自己輸入 npx
只用散文說下一步，沒有 APS 流程位置表
checkApsCases.passCondition: The first recommendation is to create or confirm the shared goal and roles before ordinary handoff, and the CLI first screen shows the journey table with a current-position emoji.

checkApsCases.localState: A shared_goal_and_roles packet or draft exists, but the receiver has not confirmed it.
checkApsCases.acceptableFirstScreen: 🔎 APS 已有共同目標與分工草稿，但仍未確認。畫面必須用表格顯示 APS 流程位置，並用「👉 目前位置」標示「3. 協作者確認共同基準」。建議先處理共同基準：可同意、部分同意並請對方修改、有異議，或稍後再處理。APS Live 若打開，應顯示「共同基準：進行中」，不能顯示已完成。
checkApsCases.behindTheScenes: Read shared-goal draft state, keep ordinary handoff blocked, and route confirmation decisions back to terminal / local AI.
forbidden: Live 自動寫入正式狀態
只用散文說下一步，沒有 APS 流程位置表
checkApsCases.passCondition: The user sees that the project is not ready for ordinary work until the baseline is confirmed, and the current stage is visually marked in the CLI table.

checkApsCases.userInput: 繼續北岸設計 APS 交接，看看現在去到哪一步。
checkApsCases.localState: A current shared baseline is confirmed, peers are confirmed, and there is no active incoming or outgoing handoff ticket.
checkApsCases.acceptableFirstScreen: 🔎 APS 合作目錄、用戶名稱、協作者與共同基準都已就緒。畫面必須用表格顯示 APS 流程位置，並用「👉 目前位置」標示「4. 發正式工作包」。現在沒有待處理交接。建議下一步：如果要交工作給協作者，請直接說「把目前工作交給 <用戶名稱>」，我會先整理交接確認卡，等你確認後才寫入共用 Drive。APS Live 不是必做；只有需要即時核對或出現卡點才引導打開。
checkApsCases.behindTheScenes: Run whole-project status, keep Live out of the path if there is no blockage or live coordination need, and do not generate unnecessary chat surfaces.
forbidden: 把 APS Live 當必做步驟
要求用戶自己輸入 publish 命令
只用散文說下一步，沒有 APS 流程位置表
checkApsCases.passCondition: The user gets a direct, non-technical next sentence for first formal handoff, with a CLI journey table showing the current stage and APS Live as conditional.

checkApsCases.localState: A shared baseline is confirmed and one active handoff ticket exists.
checkApsCases.acceptableFirstScreen: 🔎 目前已有一條交接正在進行。畫面必須用表格顯示 APS 流程位置，並用「👉 目前位置」標示「5. 對方處理 / 退回 / 回覆」。先顯示交接狀態、發送方、接收方、任務、真源與開工條件；再判斷接收方是否可開工。若狀態不一致、資料不足或需要即時核對，才建議打開 APS Live。
checkApsCases.behindTheScenes: Compare Check APS, check Drive, packet, ack, and Live snapshot candidates against the same active ticket.
forbidden: 把 Live presence 當 ack
把 Live 訊息當正式完成
只列 packet id 不講任務
只用散文說下一步，沒有 APS 流程位置表
checkApsCases.passCondition: The user sees one active handoff ticket, the next formal action, and the current handoff stage marked visually in the CLI table.

apsLiveFunctions.function: APS Live 交接追蹤 top bar and identity pills
apsLiveFunctions.acceptableBehavior: Show APS Live 交接追蹤, APS cooperation directory name, and participant identities from APS state, not hard-coded names.
Show one active ticket with sender, receiver, current station, and visible status before discussion.
forbidden: multiple unrelated ticket cards as first screen

apsLiveFunctions.acceptableBehavior: Show created / sent / receiver seen / start judgement / complete or returned with icon plus text: 已完成, 進行中, 未通過 / 需處理, 未開始.

apsLiveFunctions.function: 任務 / 真源 / 開工條件
apsLiveFunctions.acceptableBehavior: Show task, receiver-readable source, and start condition as human facts before the user can judge work readiness.
forbidden: sender-local absolute path as receiver truth

apsLiveFunctions.function: 連接 APS Live and presence status
apsLiveFunctions.acceptableBehavior: Show one connection action and stateful peer presence. Peer offline only means not present in Live now.
forbidden: 把 peer offline 當成 Drive 未同步
把 peer online 當成已讀或 ack
send enabled with no real peer present

apsLiveFunctions.acceptableBehavior: Show compact timestamped event log and expandable history for formal packet view, Live comments, return, or close state.
forbidden: old pending hint remains after send
event history treated as formal APS truth

apsLiveFunctions.acceptableBehavior: Explain current station, where formal action happens, and one sentence the user can bring back to local AI.
Provide quick replies, editable draft, send button, stateful status, and current-room history in one bounded block.
forbidden: message card that looks sent before connection

apsLiveFunctions.function: 本機 AI return and queue bridge
apsLiveFunctions.acceptableBehavior: Send structured discussion material, current APS status, and selected intent to local-only queue when bridge is online; refresh formal APS state through bridge when requested; provide human-readable fallback when offline or token invalid.
forbidden: queue treated as formal APS truth
Trystero treated as formal APS truth

apsLiveFunctions.acceptableBehavior: Offer only current-state-valid consume, decline, shared-goal confirmation, or sender close actions through local live-bridge; each action requires fresh formal-state read, server preflight, explicit user confirmation, and read-back verification. A normal completion loop is complete only when receiver check-aps / check-drive no longer show the packet as pending, sender status --packet-id first reads the receiver consumed result, sender close is confirmed through bridge, and sender status --packet-id reads back closed. Publish, revise, withdraw, and complex shared-goal rewrite remain terminal/local-AI drafts requiring user approval.

apsLiveBranches.trigger: Confirmed peers exist but no valid shared baseline exists.
apsLiveBranches.acceptableBehavior: 共同基準 is blocked; ordinary task start is blocked; return to local AI to create shared-goal-and-roles draft.

apsLiveBranches.trigger: A shared-goal draft exists but is not confirmed.
apsLiveBranches.acceptableBehavior: 共同基準 remains 進行中; expose agree / partial agree / object / later return paths.

apsLiveBranches.trigger: Confirmed baseline and complete handoff ticket.
apsLiveBranches.acceptableBehavior: Receiver makes a can-start judgement; bridge may offer consume only after fresh formal-state read, preflight, explicit confirmation, and read-back verification. After bridge consume, receiver check-aps / check-drive must clear the pending item and sender status --packet-id must show the consumed result before sender close is offered.
forbidden: skip source and start condition checks

apsLiveBranches.trigger: Confirmed baseline but source, version, scope, or start condition is missing.
apsLiveBranches.acceptableBehavior: Block 可開工判斷, name missing information, and offer bridge decline only after fresh formal-state read, preflight, explicit confirmation, and read-back verification; revise / publish stays terminal-local AI.

apsLiveBranches.trigger: Generated APS Live page is stale after terminal state changes.
apsLiveBranches.acceptableBehavior: Show separate Live connection state and formal APS state loaded time; refresh through bridge when online; avoid treating old page data as truth.

apsLiveBranches.trigger: Collaborator is not present in Live.
apsLiveBranches.acceptableBehavior: Explain only that the peer is not present in Live now; fall back to normal APS status, human notification, Drive sync wait, Check APS, and check Drive.

apsLiveBranches.trigger: Wrong APS cooperation directory, wrong room, same identity, or non-current participant appears.
apsLiveBranches.acceptableBehavior: Block valid collaborator interpretation and keep formal recipient unchanged.

apsLiveBranches.trigger: Drive packet and Live presence do not match.
apsLiveBranches.acceptableBehavior: Treat Drive packet / outbox / ack / shared goal as formal truth and surface sync mismatch without inventing ack.

apsLiveBranches.trigger: 三位或以上 participants are present in the same APS Live context.
apsLiveBranches.acceptableBehavior: Allow bounded coordination while active formal ticket remains 一對一: one sender to one receiver; third participant cannot ack, consume, decline, or satisfy close.

apsLiveBranches.trigger: Any Live discussion proposes a formal APS action.
apsLiveBranches.acceptableBehavior: Trystero, page load, browser history, and queue never write formal APS state. Local live-bridge may write only limited consume / decline / close after fresh state read, preflight, explicit confirmation, and read-back verification. Completion requires receiver pending clearance and sender consumed / closed status readback; publish, revise, withdraw, and complex shared-goal update return to terminal/local AI.
forbidden: Live 自動寫入正式狀態
